outline:
本課程旨在探討因應產業環境變化下，了解企業實際經營模式變革因應。為此，課中會有企業參訪與管理議題之研討。參訪與研討過程中，有關課程學習可以和實務參訪相呼應。
This course aims to investigate the understanding of their actual business model change , under the changes in the industrial environment. For this purpose, this course will be cover class seminars for the corporate management issues and industry visiting. During the visiting and discussion, the course learning and practical learning can be echoed.
